summary: Jefferies Financial Group Inc. filed a preliminary pricing supplement under Rule 424(b)(5) for a new issuance of Senior Autocallable Contingent Coupon Barrier Notes due July 23, 2032. The notes are linked to the worst-performing of the Nasdaq-100 Index, the VanEck Semiconductor ETF, and the S&P 500 Index. The offering is part of the company's Series A Global Medium-Term Notes program with a stated principal amount of $1,000 per note. Terms include monthly contingent coupon payments at $13.96 when the worst-performing underlying meets its coupon barrier, automatic call features beginning January 2027, and barrier protection at maturity. This filing is a routine shelf takedown for structured notes, not a special situation event.
